coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: 1401 Third Street
record.summary: A five-story, roughly 222,000 sq ft commercial office building at 1401 Third Street in Mission Bay. DataSF's Assessor tax roll (block 8721, lot 032) records the building's construction year as 2009.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8721032 (6,112 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (DataSF Building Footprints (mblr SF8721032)); 100% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 74% of the lot.

changes.text: The Assessor's rolls list this parcel at 455 Mission Bay Blvd South through 2012 and at 1401 Third Street from 2013; no source read explains why the 2007 permit gives lot 012 instead of lot 032.
1401 Third Street now uses its Assessor lot lines.

The map notes cited a CBRE listing for a different building (1455 3rd St) as a source; it was removed, and the Assessor roll for parcel 8721032 is now cited for the size, year built and office use. The record's permit source said the permit completed on 2008-04-24; the permit record says 2009-11-17, so that was corrected everywhere it appeared. The claim that 455 Mission Bay Blvd South was this parcel's address before a renaming is now stated as our inference from the permit's location, and the summary says Mission Bay instead of Mission Bay South.

open_questions: Developer, architect and current/original tenant not confirmed by any source found as of 2026-09-29.
Precise completion month not available; DataSF's Assessor tax roll gives only a year.

The permit's own block/lot (block 8721, lot 012) at filing time differs from the lot the Assessor uses for 1401 Third Street (lot 032). The permit's location point (about 6 m from the Assessor point), its description (5-story office/lab) and its 2009-11-17 completion date (the Assessor gives year built 2009) are consistent with this parcel, so it is treated as the same building. The Assessor's own rolls for lot 032 carry 455 Mission Bay Blvd South through 2012 and 1401 Third Street from 2013, which shows the address change; no source read states that the lot was renumbered from 012 to 032.
